decisions.title: Use Dafny for core logic
decisions.context: Core business logic must be correct and verifiable.
decisions.decision: Implement all core modules in Dafny with Z3-verified contracts.
decisions.consequences: Higher upfront effort but strong correctness guarantees.

decisions.title: Use relational database
decisions.context: Data is highly structured and relational.
decisions.decision: Use a relational database for persistence.

decisions.title: Expose REST API
decisions.context: External clients need a standard interface.
decisions.decision: Expose a REST API with FHIR support.
decisions.consequences: Widely supported and easy to integrate.

openRisks.mitigation: Comprehensive validation and test cases for FHIR conversion.
openRisks.description: FHIR mapping complexity may introduce conversion errors.

openRisks.mitigation: Indexing and periodic archival of audit logs.
openRisks.description: Database performance may degrade with large audit logs.

components.name: PatientRegistry
components.internals: Uses the repository pattern to store patient entities. Validates required fields (name, DOB, contact) and enforces unique patient IDs. No I/O; persistence is handled by the data store layer.

testCases.name: Register valid patient succeeds
testCases.description: Register a patient with valid demographics.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns a new patient with a unique ID and the patient is retrievable.

testCases.name: Register invalid patient fails
testCases.description: Attempt to register a patient with missing required fields.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Registration is rejected with an error.

testCases.name: Get existing patient
testCases.description: Retrieve a patient by ID after registration.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns the correct patient record.

testCases.name: Update patient demographics
testCases.description: Update a patient's contact information.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The patient record reflects the updated contact information.

testCases.name: Delete patient record
testCases.description: Delete a patient by ID.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The patient is no longer retrievable.

components.responsibility: Manages patient demographic records, unique patient IDs, and registration lifecycle. Provides CRUD operations for patient entities and enforces data validity.

components.name: ClinicalRecords
components.internals: Uses the pipeline pattern to process clinical record additions through validation and transformation. Stores records in a sequence per patient. No I/O; persistence is handled by the data store layer.

testCases.name: Add medical history entry
testCases.description: Add a medical history entry for a registered patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The entry is stored and appears in the patient's clinical history.

testCases.name: Add prescription
testCases.description: Add a prescription for a patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The prescription is stored and linked to the patient.

testCases.name: Add lab result
testCases.description: Add a lab result for a patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The lab result is stored and linked to the patient.

testCases.name: Get full clinical history
testCases.description: Retrieve all clinical records for a patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns all medical history, prescriptions, and lab results in chronological order.

components.responsibility: Tracks medical history, prescriptions, and lab results for patients. Maintains chronological clinical records and enforces data integrity.

components.name: AppointmentScheduler
components.internals: Uses the state-machine pattern to manage appointment lifecycle (Scheduled, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled). Enforces conflict-free scheduling per provider and time slot.

testCases.name: Create appointment
testCases.description: Schedule an appointment for a patient with a provider and time slot.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Appointment is created in Scheduled state.

testCases.name: Reject conflicting appointment
testCases.description: Attempt to schedule an appointment that conflicts with an existing one for the same provider.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Scheduling is rejected with a conflict error.

testCases.name: Cancel appointment
testCases.description: Cancel a scheduled appointment.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Appointment transitions to Cancelled state.

testCases.name: Reschedule appointment
testCases.description: Move an appointment to a new time slot.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Appointment time is updated and remains valid.

components.responsibility: Manages appointment scheduling, including creation, cancellation, and conflict detection. Tracks appointment status transitions.

components.name: BillingEngine
components.internals: Uses the pipeline pattern to process billing events (invoice generation, payment, claim submission). Validates amounts and enforces billing state transitions.

testCases.name: Generate invoice
testCases.description: Generate an invoice for a patient's clinical services.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Invoice is created with correct amount and status.

testCases.name: Process payment
testCases.description: Process a payment against an invoice.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Invoice balance is updated and payment is recorded.

testCases.name: Submit insurance claim
testCases.description: Submit a claim for an invoice to insurance.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Claim is created and linked to the invoice.

testCases.name: Get billing status
testCases.description: Retrieve billing status for a patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns all invoices, payments, and claims for the patient.

components.responsibility: Generates invoices, processes payments, and manages billing records for patient services. Tracks billing status and supports insurance claim submission.

components.name: FHIRIntegration
components.internals: Uses the transformer pattern to map internal entities to FHIR resources and back. Validates FHIR structure and required fields.

testCases.name: Convert patient to FHIR
testCases.description: Convert a PatientRegistry patient to a FHIR Patient resource.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns a valid FHIR Patient resource with matching fields.

testCases.name: Convert FHIR patient to internal
testCases.description: Convert a FHIR Patient resource to an internal patient record.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns a valid internal patient record.

testCases.name: Validate FHIR resource
testCases.description: Validate a FHIR resource structure.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns success for valid resources and error for invalid ones.

components.responsibility: Converts internal records to and from HL7 FHIR format. Provides FHIR resource mapping for patients, clinical records, appointments, and billing.

components.name: AuditTrail
components.internals: Uses the pipeline pattern to process audit events. Stores audit entries with timestamp, actor, action, and resource. No I/O; persistence is handled by the data store layer.

testCases.name: Log access event
testCases.description: Log an access event for a patient record.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Audit entry is stored with actor, action, and timestamp.

testCases.name: Get audit log
testCases.description: Retrieve audit entries for a patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns all access events for the patient.

components.responsibility: Records access audit trails for all system interactions. Tracks who accessed what, when, and what action was performed.

components.name: DataStore
components.internals: I/O shell wrapping database operations. Uses database-io stubs for connection and query execution. No business logic.

testCases.name: Save entity
testCases.description: Save a patient entity to the database.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Entity is persisted and retrievable.

testCases.name: Load entity
testCases.description: Load a patient entity by ID.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns the correct entity.

testCases.name: Query entities
testCases.description: Query patients by last name.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns matching patient entities.

components.responsibility: Persists and retrieves all system data (patients, clinical records, appointments, billing, audit logs) to and from a relational database.

components.name: ApiShell
components.internals: ASP.NET Core Web API. Maps HTTP endpoints to internal components. Handles authentication and authorization.

testCases.name: API register patient
testCases.description: POST /api/patients with valid patient data.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns 201 with patient ID.

testCases.name: API get patient
testCases.description: GET /api/patients/{id} for an existing patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns 200 with patient data.

testCases.name: API FHIR export
testCases.description: GET /api/fhir/Patient/{id}.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns 200 with FHIR Patient resource.

components.responsibility: Exposes the system's functionality via a REST API. Handles HTTP requests, authentication, and routing to internal components.

dataStores.name: MainDatabase
dataStores.schema: Patients, ClinicalRecords, Appointments, Invoices, Payments, Claims, AuditLogs

auth.details: JWT bearer tokens with role-based access control

systemContext: A HIPAA-compliant patient records management system supporting patient registration, medical history tracking, appointment scheduling, prescription management, lab results processing, billing, and insurance claim submission. It handles HL7 FHIR data format, maintains access audit trails, and is organized into Patient, Clinical, Billing, Scheduling, and Integration modules.

qualityAttributes.rationale: Patient data must be protected per HIPAA regulations.
Access audit trails are required for compliance.
External systems need standardized data exchange.
Patient records and billing data must be durable.

deploymentTopology: Single web server hosting the API and internal components, backed by a relational database. All components run in-process for simplicity.
